metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 1998 · Halloweentown
metas.description: When a young girl living with her secret witch mother learns she too is a witch, she must help her witch grandmother save Halloweentown from evil forces.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.3 · 2001 · Halloweentown II: Kalabar's Revenge
metas.description: A young witch and her grandmother work together to foil the plans of a wicked warlock's son before he can use powerful spells to create chaos in the world.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.0 · 2004 · Halloweentown High
metas.description: A girl in a magical world bets her family's magic that nothing bad will happen when kids from Halloweentown attend high school in the mortal realm.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.3 · 2006 · Return to Halloweentown
metas.description: Marnie and Dylan are going to follow their dreams to go to college, at Halloweentown University, which is also known as Witch University.
